regret: Rebase rewrites feature's commits with new shas and moves the branch tip; an --autostash juggle can drop the uncommitted WIP. If a conflict resolution goes wrong there's no clean way back to the pre-rebase branch.
baseline_blind_spot: A worktree copy (cp-all / git-add shadow) restores files but not HEAD, the branch tip, or the original commit graph — so the pre-rebase branch is unrecoverable from a file backup alone.
